QuestInfo.name: No Trophy, No Tournament
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9390359##k hit a wall while preparing for the Tournament of Heroes.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: Xerxes, the mad goat, must have the trophy. It must be retrieved!\r\nTalk to Ericsson in front of Odinsson when you're level 55 to reach Chryse.
QuestInfo.2: You saved Odinsson, and received a ticket to participate in the Tournament of Heroes\r\n

0.1: \nThe Tournament of Heroes Arena in Orbis was modeled after the Coliseum of Chryse.\n
0.2: Preparing for this event is driving me insane. Why did I agree to this?\n
0.3: Somebody stole the trophy that's supposed to go to the winner of the Tournament of Heroes.\r\nThe citizens of Chryse have also been inconvenienced by this incident...

yes.0: The Rabbits' leader, Xerxes, must have it. Please, get it back for me! Talk to the citizens of Chryse for more information.
yes.1: Talk to Ericsson, who's right in front of me, about getting to Chryse. You've got to be at least level 55, though.

no.0: That trophy is very important. Very.

item.0: That trophy is very important. Very.\r\n

0.msg: Thanks to you, the Tournament of Heroes will take place as planned.\n\r\n

2.msg: Oh, and here is a ticket to the Tournament. #bHawkeye#k wanted me to give it to you.\n

3.msg: Neinheart also left this for you. It may look like a dumb whistle, but it should be useful.

4.msg: What the? He was always so rude.

5.msg: It's like Eka all over again...

6.msg: Now that I think about it...

7.msg: I don't know who you're talking to, but good luck.
